 On Wednesday, Rep. Anthony Ealy , of Grandview, was arrested in Jefferson City following an incident on East Capitol Avenue.
 KRCG 
 Ealy was charged with two misdemeanors: Fourth Degree Assault and Peace Disturbance. He was taken to the Cole County Jail and held without bond. Court documents cited him as a danger to the community.
 On Friday, Ealy's office responded to KRCG 13's request for comment. 
 The email read, "Not guilty and Innocent. YHWH Yeshua. Blessing Annatoria Chitapa. I was the one approached, pushed and chased with a bat and my private residence invaded while I was just smoking a cigarette. I believe this has something to do with my Christian Faith, that I'm black and reelected. Something a prophecy. Remember the attached weird satanic symbol was placed in the kitchen above my head in my residence (where a bunch of black sentaors and reps reside) along with people who have shown up that we do not know. I do not know anything else, I want peace and for this to be wrapped up but thats all I have to say. Something else bigger is going on. YHWH Yeshua. My record speaks for itself. True prophets live through this mess."
 Marc Powers, chief of staff for the Minority Leader's Office, said Ealy had been removed from all his committees this past spring so he could focus on personal issues. He added Democratic leaders had discouraged Ealy from seeking re-election. 
 On Tuesday, Ealy retained his House seat. He won 68% of the vote in his district.
